journeys.title: Methodologist assignment through learner evidence and operational reconciliation
journeys.description: Follow one assigned course occurrence from methodologist assignment through learner progress, a failed mandatory quiz and successful retry, completion confirmation, signed-copy review, evidence-package export, and reconciliation of the current occurrence and retained history across operational views.
invariants: The methodologist assigns a published course to the learner and the assignment occurrence has a stable identity.
The learner opens the assigned course; lesson progress is scoped to that assignment occurrence and persists when moving between lessons.
A failed mandatory quiz attempt is retained and does not complete its lesson or course; a successful retry is recorded before the lesson and course can complete.
Course completion makes the learner confirmation PDF available for the completed assignment occurrence, with the employee signature area present.
The learner can append a signed scan only to their own completed training event; the methodologist can review it and acceptance is append-only.
The evidence package includes the signed copy only after an explicit methodologist acceptance and retains tenant and event ownership.
Manual reassignment creates a new occurrence while preserving the predecessor's quiz attempts, lesson progress, completion state, and training history.
Mandatory training, training-log rows and CSV export, dashboard statistics, and the action center agree on the current occurrence without erasing or double-counting retained history.
Verification uses only the documented application routes and current journey contracts; no endpoint is inferred from this contract.
journeys.dev_gate: Run the focused deterministic test selectors, then exercise the full flow in an isolated DEV tenant and reconcile current versus historical rows, dashboard/action-center state, exported PDF, and evidence package.
journeys.production_gate: Run one bounded human-style acceptance in an authorized synthetic tenant after DEV passes; verify the learner confirmation PDF, learner-uploaded signed copy, methodologist acceptance, accepted-copy package inclusion, and current/history reconciliation, then prove cleanup.
